Russia and Ukraine Exchange Overnight Strikes, Civilian Casualties Reported

Russia and Ukraine engaged in overnight strikes, resulting in civilian casualties. Reports indicate at least 7 to 10 civilians were killed and dozens injured across both nations. Ukraine claimed to have struck Russia's Novorossiysk naval base with drones and missiles. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated Ukraine has presented proposals to the U.S. for ending the war and alleged Russia plans to use upcoming elections to announce a new mobilization. Separately, Ukraine reportedly halted strikes on tankers using a Russian port at the U.S.'s request.
